quote.text: Everything we hear is an opinion, not a fact. Everything we see is a perspective, not the truth.
quote.author: Marcus Aurelius
quote.aiInsight:
• Parenthood
    • Understand that your child’s feelings and expressions are shaped by their own perspectives, not absolute truths; encourage them to explore and question the world around them.
    • Embrace the idea that opinions can differ even within the family—fostering a home environment where thoughtful discussion and empathy are valued over unquestioned acceptance.
  • Leadership
    • Recognize that the viewpoints expressed by team members are subjective and may not represent the complete picture; seek diverse opinions to make well-rounded decisions.
    • Adopt a mindset that questions apparent facts, encouraging a culture of curiosity where assumptions are examined and potential biases are openly discussed.
  • Product Management
    • Remember that customer feedback and market research represent opinions and perspectives—analyze multiple sources of data to uncover deeper insights.
    • Use this wisdom to design strategies that consider various stakeholder views, ensuring that product decisions are informed by a balanced understanding of the market rather than a single narrative.
